gr_warm_up_time.prompt: GR warmup time in simulated seconds
gr_warm_up_time.NOTE: The GR spin-up and warm-up (<job>-SPINUP / <job>-WARMUP-NN) run in <run>/gr_spinup/; the first coupled segment hard-links their last restart set into the run directory.

gcm_spin_up_time.prompt: GCM spin-up time in simulated seconds (GRX: a target; the nearest restart sets the real length)

conda_env.prompt: Conda environment to use for the simulation

local_modules.prompt: Commands to add local module PATH
local_modules.NOTE: Default: lines exporting config/machines.yaml local_prefix (PREFIX; $PREFIX/lib prepended to LIBRARY_PATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH, $PREFIX/include to CPATH, $PREFIX/bin appended to PATH), the bash form of tiegcmrun's aitken lines. No local_prefix: no lines.
